messages:
sophia: heads-up — finance flagged a ~20% delta between quota usage and billed burst credits this morning. looks correlated with a spike in retries + tool calls. anyone seen this pattern before?

mike: saw something similar in staging last week. likely double-counting on retries when tool calls re-enter the pipeline.

anna: do we have a repro? logs? the billing pipeline should dedupe using request_id but iirc tool calls generate their own request ids.

sophia: attaching quick snippet from the alert: `quota_enforcer: org=acme delta=+1200burst_tokens window=60s source=toolcall_retry` — stack traces point at token-accounting middleware.

jeff: quick theory: flow is request -> prompt tokens accounted -> tool call triggers sub-request with meta that we currently count as completion tokens in both parent and child. retries then re-account parent again.

linda: yup. also k-v cache warmups report as tokens in telemetry because tool plugins emit metadata that our kafka consumer maps to token_count.

mike: proposed short fix: 1) ensure tool calls attach parent_request_id and mark as "tool_subrequest" 2) accounting pipeline ignores tokens for subrequests unless flagged final.

anna: that needs changes in both runtime and the telemetry ETL. runtime needs to propagate parent_request_id in headers: `X-Parent-Req: <id>` and a flag `X-Tool-Subrequest: true`.

jeff: but watch out for streaming completions — we currently flush token metrics on each stream chunk. if a tool call does streaming we may still double-count.

linda: suggestion: only emit per-request aggregate tokens at stream close (or when `stream_end=true`) for billing-sensitive counters. emit intermediate counters to observability only.

sophia: UX question: how should this surface in console? customers seeing spike will want to know "why my burst credits dropped".

mike: add a per-key breakdown that shows reconciled tokens vs raw telemetry, with an explanation for retries/toolcalls. toggles: show/hide subrequests.

anna: ops action plan: short term -> ETL filter to dedupe subrequests by matching parent id; medium -> runtime propagate parent id and only one accounting emit per logical request; long -> roll out client-side idempotency hints so retries are explicit.

jeff: can we avoid schema churn? maybe add `meta.request_kind` = ["root","tool_subrequest","retry"] in event envelope. ETL can be forward compatible with default root.

linda: i'll add an event example to the docs. example envelope: ```{\n  "req_id": "abc123",\n  "parent_id": "pabc123",\n  "request_kind": "tool_subrequest",\n  "prompt_tokens": 120,\n  "completion_tokens": 0,\n  "stream_end": true\n}```

infra-bot: deploy queued: telemetry-v2 (etl-filter) to staging at 02:00 UTC.

sophia: thanks — mike/anna please pair on runtime change. jeff/linda please update ETL and console mocks. custo-facing note: we'll show reconciled delta and a tooltip explaining tool_subrequests and retries.

mike: quick nit — what about burst window semantics? right now enforcer charges per-second bucket then deducts burst credits. if we hold off charging until stream_end we might temporarily allow more tokens than enforcement intends.

anna: true. compromise: reserve tokens early (soft-reserve) but convert to hard charge on stream_end. if a retry duplicates, reservation can be released by parent_id match.

jeff: approach seems reasonable. need to define release TTL — i suggest 30s to avoid holding forever on stalled streams.

linda: will draft the ETL filter and console mock by EOD. can someone add a test plan? need unit tests for: dedupe by parent_id, stream_end only final charge, reservation release TTL, and per-key reconciled display.

mike: I'll add integration tests in runtime repo. tests should simulate: nested toolcalls, streaming tool responses, and immediate retry storms.

sophia: awesome. if infra-bot posts staging results, bump this to prod rollout board. thanks all :tada:
